confidence_notes: Food anchors (inexpensive meal, mid-range meal, cappuccino) are based on search snippets from aggregated price sites and one Punjab dhaba review, cross-checked against India-wide cappuccino averages; they are bounded estimates, not verified menu prices. Beer, cocktail and wine rest mainly on Mumbai and Delhi hotel and bar menus, so they are likely high for Amritsar, and cocktail and wine are set by rough local price relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation searches or live booking pages were consulted. The FX value (0.6720 USD per AUD, 18 Nov 2026) came from a search snippet that cited the RBA 4pm rate; the rba.gov.au page itself was not opened, and no 19 Nov reading was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Punjab tourism city in India with prices below metro levels (Delhi, Mumbai). Food anchors draw on India-wide aggregated cappuccino averages and budget-to-mid-range dining references. Beer, cocktail and wine use local price relationships to beer, adjusted down from metro hotel-bar menus. Accommodation reflects the city's Golden Temple-area hostel and guesthouse market, estimated from general knowledge.
